# GROTEC FarmerOS

> GROTEC FarmerOS is a private, login-gated CRM and HRMS platform for GROTEC Organic Private Limited, an agricultural inputs company in India.

## About
This is an internal business operations platform. All pages beyond /login require authenticated sessions.

## Capabilities
- CRM: Lead management, customer registry, telecaller workspace, relationship manager, crop advisory.
- HRMS: Employee identity, attendance (ESSL biometric), leave, payroll (PF/ESI/TDS), payslips, KPI scoring.
- Notifications & Audit log.

## Technology
React 18, NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL. Domain: https://grotec.in
